pages.text: The final fragment told you how. You will need:$(li)a $(l)Void Heart$(): eight Void Shards bound around an Echo Shard$(li)an altar raised $(l)in the Hollow$()$(li)$(l)eight Voidstone Ore$(), carried out whole with Silk Touch$(li)200 mana, and the will to finish it
pages.title: The Ritual of Waking

pages.text: Cold. Heavy. Something inside it beats, very slowly.

pages.name: Ritual of Waking
pages.text: Build it on solid ground, with room to fight. Offer the Void Heart.

$(li)He grows more desperate as he weakens.$(li)His touch $(l)corrupts$(). Do not let him close.$(li)Bring a way to cleanse yourself, and a way home.$(li)Build your arena on a wide island. The void will not save you, or him.
